meta.title: Rats of Thornhill
meta.premise: Thornhill's grain cellars have been emptied by something the villagers will only call "the rats", and the mill's undercroft has been bricked shut from the inside. Kael has been paid to open it, but the tithe barn is the only building still unlocked after dark.

entities.name: the tithe barn
entities.brief: A stone barn with its doors left ajar and lanterns flickering, the only building still unlocked after dark.

detail.description: The barn's interior smells of hay and faint oil, with a wooden trapdoor half concealed beneath a stack of hay.
detail.hook: A hidden trapdoor beneath the hay suggests a stairwell leading down into the grain cellars.

entities.name: the grain cellars
entities.brief: Empty stone bins line the walls, the scent of stale grain clinging to the air.

detail.description: The cellars are barren, the faint sound of distant squeaks echoing off the walls.
detail.hook: A narrow, hidden passage behind a broken sack seems to lead toward the mill's undercroft.

entities.name: the mill entrance
entities.brief: An old wooden mill by the river, its wheel still, its doors bricked shut from the inside.

detail.description: The mill's doors are sealed by a layer of bricks, damp with river spray, and a keyhole glints faintly.
detail.hook: A loose brick near the door hints at a possible way to pry it open, if only you had a tool.

entities.name: the mill undercroft
entities.brief: A dark vaulted chamber beneath the mill, sealed and bristling with cobblestones.

detail.description: The undercroft smells of earth and rot, its entrance barred by heavy stones.
detail.hook: The stones seem movable with a strong tool or a key, offering a way forward.

entities.name: Eldric, the old miller
entities.brief: A gaunt figure with soot‑streaked hands, the keeper of the mill who is rumored to possess a key to the undercroft.

detail.description: Eldric leans against the bricked doorway, his eyes flickering with the memory of the mill's secrets.
detail.hook: He mentions a rusted iron key hidden in his coat, crucial for prying the stone lock.

entities.name: a swarming mass of rats
entities.brief: A torrent of rats that have emptied the grain cellars, eyes gleaming with hunger.

detail.description: The rats scurry in endless waves, gnashing their teeth and dropping crumbs.
detail.hook: The rats seem to guard something in the darkness, perhaps a clue to their motives.

entities.name: Lysa, the barn keeper
entities.brief: A sturdy woman who watches over the tithe barn, lantern in hand.

detail.description: Lysa wipes her hands on a woolen cloth, eyes ever watchful of the night’s whispers.
detail.hook: She mentions the rats' sudden appearance and hints that the cellar walls may hold a secret passage.

entities.name: a rusted iron key
entities.brief: An iron key, rusted and heavy, that seems to fit a large stone lock.

detail.description: The key's teeth are worn, but its shape matches the lock sealing the mill's undercroft.
detail.hook: If you can get hold of this key, the stone door may be pried open.

entities.name: the village square of Thornhill
entities.brief: A cobbled square with a stone well and a few weathered stalls, the heart of the village.

detail.description: The square is quiet at night, the well's stone edges slick with damp, and the occasional rat scurries by. A lone stall holds a basket of dried herbs.
detail.hook: A loose stone by the well hints at a hidden passage to the grain cellars.

threads.title: Opening the Undercroft
threads.note: Kael needs to find the key and unlock the stone door to access the undercroft beneath the mill.

memories.text: The grain cellars were emptied overnight as a swarming horde of rats poured in from unseen tunnels, leaving only husks of grain behind.
Eldric keeps a rusted iron key hidden in his coat, the only thing that can pry the stone lock sealing the mill's undercroft.

hooks.note: The rusted iron key is found and can be used to pry open the stone lock sealing the mill undercroft. The passage to the undercroft is now known.
Having pried open the stone lock, the undercroft chamber is revealed.
Old Miller is discovered, revealing the rusted iron key he carries.
